_schema: Small, hand-curated, conservative reference table of well-established sports-card manufacturer/brand/insert facts (e.g. 'Downtown is a Panini insert, not Topps'). This is NOT sourced from checklist scraping or a model - it is basic, stable, widely-documented hobby-industry fact, kept intentionally short. Only add an entry here when you are highly confident it is correct and unlikely to be disputed - a wrong entry here is worse than no entry, since the backend treats this file as ground truth it will never let the model contradict. Mirrors the same manufacturer/brand set app.html's own PRODIMG/REALPROD constants already assume (Prizm/Select/Donruss/Donruss Optic/Mosaic = Panini, Topps Chrome/Bowman Chrome/Finest = Topps), so this file does not introduce any fact the rest of the app doesn't already treat as true.

inserts.name: Downtown
inserts.notes: A Panini case-hit insert seeded across multiple Panini brands and sports depending on the year (most consistently Donruss/Donruss Optic Football). It is not a Topps product.

inserts.name: Kaboom
inserts.notes: A Panini Mosaic case-hit insert. Not a Topps product.

inserts.name: Color Blast
inserts.notes: A Panini Phoenix case-hit insert. Not a Topps product.
